description:
## Origin

Stellation Pass 10 Arc 1 close (2026-05-18) — CATO observed substrate-generated transient files showing as untracked on consumer-tier workspace:
- `.claude/scheduled_tasks.lock` (durable cron state file per CronCreate `durable: true`)
- `.claude/worktrees/` (per-arc-build worktree directory; transient empty-dir residue post-merge on Windows due to file-lock from in-flight processes)

Filed at stellation as stellati-k23 item 2; routed to the-stoa for canonical substrate-tier resolution.

## Failure mode

install.sh deploys substrate to a consumer workspace but does NOT manage the consumer's .gitignore. Operators have to manually add substrate-generated transient paths to their project's .gitignore OR live with untracked-state noise in `git status` output. This noise:
- Pollutes `git status` readability (substantive uncommitted changes hidden in noise)
- Risks accidental `git add .` of cache state
- Is identical-shape across every consumer workspace (same transient paths)

## Fix shape

Add canonical-.gitignore management to install.sh (or as a sibling skill). Options:

(α) **Generate-or-append**: install.sh writes a `.claude/.gitignore` covering substrate-internal transient paths (scheduled_tasks.lock + worktrees/ + .substrate-last-check + maybe pycache); consumer's root .gitignore can be a one-liner `.claude/.gitignore` reference OR install.sh appends to root .gitignore conditionally if `--manage-gitignore` flag set.

(β) **Document-only**: install.sh prints a one-line recommendation at end of run ("Append the following lines to .gitignore: ...") + offers `--print-gitignore-lines` flag for scripted append.

(γ) **Self-contained .claude/**: move all substrate-internal transient state under `.claude/_state/` and add the entire `_state/` dir to the canonical layout (consumer .gitignore one-liner = `.claude/_state/`).

User-tier weakly leans α-with-flag (cleanest; explicit consent; existing flag pattern from --modify-claude-md / --no-bw-init / etc.). DAEDALUS picks at design time.

## Acceptance criteria

1. install.sh emits (or offers) canonical .gitignore additions for substrate-generated transient paths.
2. Document in install.sh --help + substrate README which paths are transient (operator-readable).
3. Post-fix verification: fresh install.sh at a clean workspace + `git status` shows no untracked substrate-transient paths.

## Sequencing

P3. Substrate-canon edit. Arc 43+ (post-stellation Pass 10 completion). Pairs naturally with sp1 (port utilities) since both touch install.sh discipline.

## Cross-references

- stellati-k23 item 2 — origin observation at stellation
- substrate/install.sh write_substrate_manifest (Arc 38) + post-copy pycache cleanup (Arc 40) — existing install.sh substrate-transient-state hygiene precedents
- sp1, 3na — adjacent install.sh-discipline tickets
